hypothesis: Persistent global corrections to a shared endpoint-conditioned sheaf learner may encode useful graph-wide operator modes more efficiently than the incidence-factorized BSNN family inspected here; private feature corrections may support those modes within one shared weight bank.
specific_primary_limitation: BSNN §3.2 factorizes the conditional variational sheaf distribution over incidences for tractable KL; §3.3 constructs distributions from input features and independently samples one sheaf per layer.
strongest_alternative_explanation: An ordinary structured or global-latent, state-conditioned BSNN could recover the coupling; a joint multi-transport single model or private node/head adapters could recover the predictive effect.
required_distinctions: persistent learned geometry versus sampled or fixed-draw geometry
transport parameter ownership versus feature/head ownership and geometry induced by private states
mean own supervised loss versus MC likelihood plus prior KL versus pooled prediction loss
raw map disagreement versus gauge-aware effective-operator differences with predictive utility
stored parameters versus complete graph training and serving cost
falsifying_controls: competent ordinary deterministic NSD and BSNN at the same serving-path/resource budget
global-correlated and state-conditioned BSNN, with persistence versus resampling isolated
genuine independent NSD members with each own restored checkpoint and pooled probabilities
joint multi-transport single model with all the same live states and a competent readout
transport-only, feature/head-only, shared conditional-map and shared-state ownership controls
flat/node-frame, layer-shared matrix and matched node-adapter capacity controls
stop_conditions: competent BSNN or independent/joint controls recover the claimed quality/cost benefit
private feature/head or node-frame capacity explains the effect
geometry differs only through gauge or has no downstream predictive utility
serving and training work remove the practical resource benefit
members collapse or fail to retain competent own predictive quality
